## Required review checklist

- [ ] I read the active documents in the repository's canonical authority order.
- [ ] This change preserves the complete retained state and does not introduce a scalar substitute.
- [ ] Inputs, operators, coefficients, domains, methods, tolerances, and boundary conditions are explicit.
- [ ] Any changed execution semantics use a new contract/runtime identity where required.
- [ ] Native results were frozen before comparator access, or comparator access is explicitly disclosed.
- [ ] Terminal codes, adverse outcomes, transcripts, artifacts, manifests, and hashes are retained where applicable.
- [ ] Claim, evidence, closure, and standing records are synchronized where affected.
- [ ] The R28-to-R24 interaction authority and prohibited-substitution rules are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Public wording remains within the exact certified scope.
- [ ] Validation demonstrates the intended effect without altering unrelated certified results.
